# TRACKRAT

> TRACKRAT is a free community sprint club based in Austin, Texas. We meet for track workouts every Sunday morning and Thursday evening. All levels, all speeds welcome. No membership fees, no sign-ups — just show up.


## Identity

- **Name:** TRACKRAT (often "TRACKRAT Sprint Club")
- **City:** Austin, Texas, USA
- **Cost:** Free
- **Sign-up required:** No
- **Tagline:** "SPRINT CLUB > RUN CLUB"


## Meeting Times

- **Sunday Sprints** — 8:30 AM, weekly, at the track at 4401 Tilley St, Austin, TX 78723
- **Thursday Midweek Workout** — 6:30 PM, weekly, location varies (announced via @trackratsprintclub Instagram story the day of)

Both sessions run year-round.

**A typical workout:** group warm-up (dynamic movement + a 400 at warm-up pace), then a workout ranging from 400s down to 200s and 100s (~1 mile net distance), then a group cool-down. Runners can pair up with people their speed or with someone more seasoned to learn from.


## Culture

TRACKRAT is structured but not coached competitively. Beginners line up next to former collegiate sprinters. Every workout has a plan; runners pick their own intensity. Common questions and characteristics:

- **Beginner-friendly:** yes. All speeds welcome — from first-timers to sub-elite.
- **Drop-in:** yes. No commitment required; come when you can.
- **Coaching:** workouts are programmed (not freelance), but there is no individual coaching or paid instruction.
- **Equipment:** bring running shoes. The track provides everything else.
- **Vibe:** community-first. People stay for coffee after Sunday Sprints.


## Pages

- [Home](https://www.trackratsprint.club/) — Landing page with about/FAQ content
- [Schedule](https://www.trackratsprint.club/schedule) — Weekly meet times, locations, .ics calendar download, Google Maps links
- [Brand](https://www.trackratsprint.club/brand) — Brand guide (voice, naming conventions, visual identity)
- [2026 Invitational](https://www.trackratsprint.club/invitational) — TRACKRAT's hosted community sprint meet (under the Events menu)
- [OFFTRACK](https://www.trackratsprint.club/offtrack) — Demo night in Austin presented by TRACKRAT (under the Events menu)
- [Dashboard](https://www.trackratsprint.club/dashboard) — Authenticated member dashboard: log PRs and view member promotions (Google sign-in required; private per user)
- [Shop](https://shop.trackratsprint.club) — Apparel and merchandise


## API

- `GET /api/next-event` — Returns the next upcoming meet as JSON with fields: `display` (date string), `weekday`, `iso`, `time`, `location`, `type` (`sunday` or `thursday`), `title`. Edge runtime, America/Chicago timezone.
